title: test-syndiffix
summary: A test and measurement harness for evaluating the privacy-preserving synthesizer SynDiffix, running SLURM-based experiments that build synthetic data with several methods and score it for quality, ML efficacy, and privacy. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TabularPreset and PARSynthesizer models as comparison baselines and uses sdmetrics directly to generate quality reports.
